class.name: PhysXShaderOptimizer
class.experimental: New: its results may still change.
class.brief_description: Finds the shaders a project's materials use that could be one shader, and merges them (the editor's Project > Tools > Optimize Shaders), provided by the PhysX module.

method.name: code_without_defaults
method.description: [param code] with its parameters' default values left out: [code]uniform float x = 1.0;[/code] becomes [code]uniform float x;[/code]. Instance and global uniforms are kept whole, as their defaults can't be set on a material. Two shaders with the same result can be merged.

method.name: find_groups
find_materials
method.description: The [ShaderMaterial]s saved in their own files ([code].tres[/code], [code].res[/code]) under [param dir] and its subfolders (not hidden folders such as [code].godot[/code], nor folders with a [code].gdignore[/code]). Materials built into scenes aren't included.

method.name: find_material_paths
method.description: The paths of the files [method find_materials] would load, without loading them (each file's type is read from its header). Loading them one by one shows progress in a big project.

method.name: merge_group
method.description: Moves a group's materials (from [method find_groups]) onto its kept shader and sets their parameters. Nothing is saved.
